pics.alt: Title page of the 1713 second edition of Montmort's Essay d'analyse sur les jeux de hazard, printed in Paris by Jacque Quillau
pics.caption: Title page of the second edition (Paris, 1713) of Pierre Rémond de Montmort's Essay d'analyse sur les jeux de hazard. The book, first published in 1708, contains the problème des rencontres, the counting of derangements.

pics.alt: Line drawing of the permutohedron of order 4, a truncated octahedron whose 24 vertices are labelled with the permutations of 1, 2, 3, 4
pics.caption: The permutohedron of order 4: its 24 vertices are the permutations of (1, 2, 3, 4), joined by an edge when they differ by exchanging two entries with consecutive values. Its edge graph is a Cayley graph of S₄ generated by adjacent transpositions.
pics.title: Permutohedron.svg
